text: 金十数据10月6日讯，美国前财政部长耶伦批评总统特朗普对待美国盟友的方式，并表示支持针对保护主义措施采取反制行动。耶伦在回应加拿大前财政部长克里斯蒂娅·弗里兰有关特朗普对盟友加征关税，以及试图将美国对盟友的安全承诺“货币化”的提问时表示：“我认为这令人震惊。我完全理解为什么你们会觉得遭到了美国的背叛，也完全理解你们为何如此愤怒。”耶伦表示，加拿大应该针对特朗普实施的关税采取报复性措施。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 6 - Former U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen criticized President Trump's treatment of U.S. allies and expressed support for countermeasures against protectionist measures. In response to a question from former Canadian Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland about Trump imposing tariffs on allies and trying to "monetize" U.S. security commitments to allies, Yellen said: "I think this is appalling. I completely understand why you would feel betrayed by the United States, and I completely understand why you are so angry." Yellen said Canada should take retaliatory measures against the tariffs imposed by Trump.
